cases.name: Treasure receipt
cases.text: You may sacrifice one or more Treasures. When you do, up to that many target creatures gain double strike until end of turn.

cases.name: Shifted receipt
cases.text: Draw two cards. You may sacrifice one or more Treasures. When you do, up to that many target creatures gain double strike until end of turn.

cases.name: Shifted parent target
cases.text: Target player gains 2 life. You may sacrifice one or more Treasures. When you do, up to that many target creatures gain double strike until end of turn.

cases.name: Actual discard receipt
cases.text: You may discard any number of cards. When you do, up to that many target creatures each get -2/-2 until end of turn.

cases.name: Shifted discard receipt
cases.text: Draw two cards. You may discard any number of cards. When you do, up to that many target creatures each get -2/-2 until end of turn.

cases.name: Filtered actual discard
cases.text: You may discard one or more land cards. When you do, return up to that many target nonland permanent cards from your graveyard to your hand.

cases.name: Later callback body
cases.text: You may sacrifice one or more Treasures. When you do, up to that many target creatures gain double strike until end of turn. Draw two cards.
